{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter to converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Step 2: Check for sentinel values in age
missing_age_count = (converted_customers['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of converted customers with missing age (coded as -1): {missing_age_count}")

# Step 3: Compute mean age, excluding -1 as missing
mean_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
